senses.gloss: m. pl. (טרז = טרד II; cmp. טְרוּזָא) [locked up things, cmp. אוֹצָר,] royal wardrobe, armory.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 56a:19">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>ריש ט׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="I00222"><he>טורזינא</he></cite>, Ar. <cite ref="I00742"><he>טרזיא</he></cite>) the chief of the royal wardrobe dreamt.

<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:19">Ib.</cite> <he>אתיוה לריש ט׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>אמר קיסר אייתיה לריש טריא</he>) they brought the chief … up, and he was put do death. [For Var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. notes 1, 2.]
